analysis: Brinzolamide is a carbonic anhydrase inhibitor used primarily in the treatment of glaucoma. It functions by decreasing the production of aqueous humor, thereby reducing intraocular pressure in the eye. Brinzolamide is a reversible and competitive inhibitor of the carbonic anhydrase enzyme, meaning it competes with the natural substrate for binding to the active site of the enzyme and its inhibition can be reversed.
